notes: Custom-colour swatch made unmistakable: the end swatch on the Colour (and Glow) row is now a circle with a white '+' and a light ring, so it's always visible — even if the rainbow gradient isn't supported, the '+' (plain text) and border still render. Clicking it opens the OS colour picker (transient <input type=color>). This replaces relying on a gradient alone, which wasn't showing on Safari.
